items.title: Deploy frontier AI models on AWS Trainium with SGLang-Neuron
items.summary: SGLang-Neuron is now publicly available through an AWS Deep Learning Container. With SGLang-Neuron, you can serve models and generate reinforcement learning rollouts with SGLang on AWS Trainium using the same SGLang interface you already know, all running on native PyTorch.
items.creator: Alex Nails
